title: RSVP collaborative BCI dataset from Zheng et al 2020
description: A cross-session EEG dataset for collaborative brain-computer interfaces based on rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP). Fourteen healthy participants, organized in seven pairs, performed a target image detection task (human vs non-human images) with synchronized 62-channel EEG recorded across two sessions. The dataset supports research on P300/ERP-based target detection and collaborative BCI methods.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan Synamps2 system at 1000 Hz from 62 channels, referenced to the vertex (Cz). Participants viewed RSVP image streams with a 100 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Each subject completed 2 sessions of 3 runs, with 168 target and 4032 non-target trials in total. Pairs of subjects were recorded simultaneously.
